messages.content: What is the weather in Binda NSW

I'll search for the current weather in Binda, NSW for you.Right then, Shaun! Based on the latest data from the Bureau of Meteorology, here's what's happening in Binda, NSW:

Currently it's 23.6°C with no rain since 9 am. 

For today's forecast, expect showers with a low of 15°C and high of 21°C, with a high chance of showers becoming less likely in the evening. There's a chance of a thunderstorm, possibly severe, with winds from the east at 15 to 25 km/h.

So it's a bit of a mixed bag—warm enough at the moment, but you'll want to keep an eye out for those showers and potential storms later. Not exactly ideal weather for a picnic, but nothing catastrophic either. Cheers!

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a command on the local machine and return its output. Use this for system tasks like listing files, checking processes, reading/writing files, getting system info, running scripts, installing software, or any other local operation. Commands run with the current user's permissions. On Windows this runs PowerShell; on macOS this runs bash. IMPORTANT: When launching GUI applications, use Start-Process (Windows) or 'open -a' (macOS) so the command returns immediately instead of blocking.

tools.name: csv_search
tools.description: Search a delimited text file (CSV, TSV, TXT, etc.) for records matching a value. The file must have a header row. You can search a specific column or all columns. Returns matching rows as formatted text. Use this whenever the user asks to find, look up, or filter data in a CSV, TSV, or delimited text file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file (CSV, TSV, TXT, etc.)

delimiter.description: Column delimiter character. Use ',' for CSV (default), '\t' for tab-separated, '|' for pipe-separated, ';' for semicolons. If omitted, auto-detects from file content.

column.description: Column heading to search in. If omitted, searches all columns.

match_mode.description: How to match: 'contains' (default), 'exact', or 'starts_with'. All modes are case-insensitive.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching rows to return (default 50).
